description: This source file implements the SocketPort class and related functions for socket management, including creation, configuration, connection handling, data transmission, and multicast group management, with platform-specific code for Windows, POSIX, Linux, and Apple systems.

classes.name: WinSocketInitializer
classes.description: Initializes Windows Sockets API and retrieves function pointers for WSARecvMsg.

methods.name: ReceiveFrom
methods.description: Receives data from a socket, with platform-specific handling for control messages to extract interface index.

methods.name: DestroySocket
methods.description: Closes and invalidates a socket handle.

methods.name: SetNonBlocking
methods.description: Sets a socket to non-blocking mode, platform-specific implementation.

methods.name: ConstructSocket
methods.description: Creates and configures a socket based on NodeId and interface parameters, with platform-specific code.

methods.name: BufferAlignment
methods.description: Adjusts socket buffer sizes and allocates send/receive buffers.

methods.name: Identifier
methods.description: Generates a string identifier for a NodeId.

methods.name: WaitForOpen
methods.description: Waits until the socket is open or timeout occurs.

methods.name: WaitForWriteComplete
methods.description: Waits until all pending write data is sent or timeout occurs.

methods.name: WaitForClosure
methods.description: Waits until the socket is closed or timeout occurs.

methods.name: Events
methods.description: Determines socket events to monitor based on socket state.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Handles socket events, calling appropriate methods for read, write, accept, or close.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the socket into the receive buffer.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Sends data from the send buffer over the socket.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the socket and cleans up resources.

methods.name: Trigger
methods.description: Signals the socket to process pending events.

methods.name: Accept
methods.description: Accepts an incoming connection, returning a new socket handle.
